name.zh: 网球数据摘要 - ATP/WTA 比赛数据

description.en: Archival mirror of professional tennis datasets compiled by Jeff Sackmann (Tennis Abstract), preserving ATP and WTA match results, rankings, player biographical data, and match statistics in CSV format. The ATP/WTA snapshots were taken in June 2026; this archive is not a continuously updated feed. Redistributed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
description.zh: Jeff Sackmann（Tennis Abstract）职业网球数据集的归档镜像，以CSV格式保存ATP和WTA比赛结果、排名、球员传记数据及比赛统计。ATP/WTA快照采集于2026年6月；此归档并非持续更新的数据源。按知识共享署名-非商业性使用-相同方式共享4.0国际许可证（CC BY-NC-SA 4.0）再分发。

en: ATP player biographical data (name, birth date, country, playing hand, height)
WTA player biographical data (name, birth date, country, playing hand)
Historical ATP rankings from 1973 through June 2026 (with gaps in early years)
Historical WTA rankings from 1975 through June 2026
ATP match results from 1968 to June 2026 (tour-level, challengers, futures, qualifying)
WTA match results from 1968 to June 2026 (tour-level, ITF, qualifying)
Detailed match statistics including aces, double faults, service points, break points
Point-by-point data for select Grand Slam matches, 2011–2024
zh: ATP球员传记数据（姓名、出生日期、国家、握拍手、身高）
WTA球员传记数据（姓名、出生日期、国家、握拍手）
1973年至2026年6月的ATP历史排名（早期年份有间断）
1968年至2026年6月的ATP比赛结果（巡回赛级别、挑战赛、期货赛、资格赛）
1968年至2026年6月的WTA比赛结果（巡回赛级别、ITF、资格赛）
详细的比赛统计数据，包括ace球、双误、发球得分、破发点
2011年至2024年部分大满贯比赛的逐分数据
